title: Landlines Vanished While Robocalls Nearly Doubled
hook: Home phones disappeared, but unwanted calling grew instead of fading.
closing: The phone changed, yet unwanted calls became more common rather than less.
question: Do you answer unknown numbers?

segments.say: By 2024, 76% of adults had no landline. Wireless-only homes became the clear majority.
Telemarketing made up 36% of robocalls in 2024. Commercial calling led the unwanted-call mix.
Annual robocalls reached 52.8 billion in 2024. The volume nearly doubled as landlines became uncommon.
